title: John Mack's experiencer support group and its two camps

tellings.quote: when I went to his support groups, I noticed that they were in my from my perspective, I saw two different camps of people.

plain: Jim Weiner, a man who says he was abducted by aliens, says he went to support groups run by John Mack, a man who worked with people reporting such experiences, in the Boston area. Weiner says that, from where he sat, the people in those groups split into two different camps. He tells it to show that people who say they were taken did not all see their experiences the same way.
